qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Global market leadership in railway switch systems and proprietary specialty processing in High Performance Metals provide technological niche barriers. However, heavy consolidated exposure to cyclical European automotive and industrial end-markets dilutes returns. 10-year ROCE/ROIC averages 5-7%, falling well short of the 12% cost-of-capital hurdle. Decarbonization capex ('greentec steel' electric arc furnaces in Linz and Donawitz) further burdens multi-year free cash flow.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC & Pricing Power, REJECT). Niche engineering strength in railway turnouts and tool steel cannot insulate the group from European automotive and steel industrial cyclicality. 10-year average ROCE/ROIC of 5-7% fails the 12% compounding hurdle, while green steel electric arc transition capex absorbs substantial operational cash flow.
qualitative.evidence: 10-year historical ROCE/ROIC has averaged between 5% and 7%, dipping to 3-5% during industrial downturns and only temporarily exceeding 12% during peak post-pandemic supply constraints. The business is heavily exposed to the European automotive sector (>30% of sales), facing structural volume stagnation and cost inflation in domestic Austrian energy.
